svg.title: Choosing a method in surveyframe: Measure a construct
svg.desc: Reliability with alpha or omega. An unknown structure goes to the readiness check, then the exploratory factor analysis. A specified structure goes to CFA, CB-SEM or PLS-SEM syntax.
